name: bibtex-manager
description: Search and append BibTeX entries to your library from inside VS Code.

bibtexManager.libraryFilePath.description: Workspace-relative path to the .bib file new entries are appended to. The .bib extension is added if omitted.

bibtexManager.bibKey.usePattern.description: Generate the BibTeX key from a pattern instead of using the upstream key.

bibtexManager.bibKey.pattern.markdownDescription:
Pattern used when `#bibtexManager.bibKey.usePattern#` is enabled.

| Pattern | Description |
|---|---|
| `\a(n)` | Last names of the first n authors. |
| `\Y` | The full year. |
| `\y` | The last two digits of the year. |
| `\T(n)` | The first n words of the title. |
| `\t(n)` | First letter of each of the first n words in the title. |
| `\D` | DOI. |

Use `(0)` to include all names/words. Other characters in the pattern are kept verbatim.

bibtexManager.semanticScholar.apiKey.markdownDescription: Optional Semantic Scholar API key, sent as the `x-api-key` header. Keys are issued by request at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api#api-key. Leaving this empty uses the shared unauthenticated rate limit, which is frequently saturated and returns 429.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile:tests && npm run lint
